info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Creditcard Applications Activate-v2-spec
info.description: The Activate Credit Card Applications API enables businesses to efficiently activate credit card applications on behalf of customers. This API facilitates the process of confirming and enabling new credit card accounts, ensuring that users can access their cards promptly after approval. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and online banking platforms that need to streamline the onboarding of new credit card holders. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer satisfaction through swift activation services.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to activate an application by its identifier. Upon activation, the application will be ready for use. Ensure that all necessary preconditions are met before activating the application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to activate an application. It should contain all necessary parameters required for the activation process.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the application is activated.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the application.

customer.description: Information about the customer associated with the application.

resource.description: The resource identifier related to the application.

priority.description: Priority level of the application request.

amount.description: The monetary amount associated with the application.

currency.description: The currency code for the amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether notification is required for the application.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the request was made.

channel.description: The channel through which the application is submitted.

recordIndex.description: Index of the record in a list context, if applicable.

CreateCreditcardApplicationsActivateRequ.description: Schema representing the request body for activating an application.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates if the customer is a VIP.

CreateCreditcardApplicationsActivateResp.title: Application Activation Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the activation process.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the activation request.

resultId.description: An ID representing the result of the activation process.

state.description: The current state of the application after activation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the activation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Any message related to the activation process, usually provides additional details.

CreateCreditcardApplicationsActivateResp.description: This schema represents the response for activating an application.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the activation entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the activation entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the activation was automated or manual.

AuditInfo.description: Schema for audit information related to the application activation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A lower value implies better performance.
